t: You're outside the Gillian Lynne Theatre, a West End theatre on the corner of Drury Lane and Parker Street. The Winter Garden Theatre occupied this site until 1965. In May 2018 it was renamed in honour of the choreographer Gillian Lynne, making it the first West End theatre named after a non-royal woman. She is known for her choreography on Cats and The Phantom of the Opera, and was made a Dame at the age of eighty-seven.
